test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A bus covers the first 70 km of its journey in 40 minutes and the remaining 60 km in 30 minutes. The average speed of the bus, in km/h, is:
solution:
**Given:**

First part of journey: 70 km in 40 minutes

Second part of journey: 60 km in 30 minutes

**Concept Used:**

Average speed is calculated by the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken.

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 70 km + 60 km = 130 km

Total Time = 40 minutes + 30 minutes = 70 minutes

Convert time to hours: 70 minutes = 70/60 hours = 7/6 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 130 km / (7/6) hours

⇒ Average Speed = 130 km × (6/7)

⇒ Average Speed = 780/7 km/h

⇒ Average Speed = 111 (3/7) km/h

**∴ The average speed of the bus is 111 (3/7) km/h.**
